slides.title: Background: What is physiology?
slides.english_text:
Background: What is physiology?
What is “physiology”?
• Physiology is scientific study of:
• normal conditions and activities of a living organism
• and functions and mechanisms of body parts for maintaining survival.
• Content of “human physiology”:
• (1) Normal conditions of human body
• (2) Functions of human cells, tissues, and organs for achieving normal conditions
slides.raw_bilingual_text:
Background: What is physiology?
背景：什麼是生理學？
What is “physiology”? 什麼是「生理學」？
• Physiology is scientific study of: 生理學是關於以下方面的科學研究：
• normal conditions and activities of a living organism
生物的正常狀態和活動
• and functions and mechanisms of body parts for maintaining survival.
及維持生存所需的身體不同部位的功能和機制。
• Content of “human physiology”:「人體生理學」內容：
• (1) Normal conditions of human body 人體的正常狀態
• (2) Functions of human cells, tissues, and organs for achieving normal
conditions 達到人體正常狀態所需的細胞、組織和器官的功能

slides.title: Organization of Human Body
slides.english_text:
Organization of Human Body
• The organization of the human body can be broken down into several levels, from the simplest to the most complex, namely:
• Chemical level: different chemicals (E.g. proteins)
• Cellular level: single cell
• Tissue level: groups of similar cells
• Organ level: discrete structure, which contains two or more types of tissues, for specific functions
• Organ system level: several organs that work closely together
• Organism level: all organ systems combined to make the whole organism
slides.raw_bilingual_text:
Organization of Human Body
人體的組織結構
• The organization of the human body can be broken down into several levels, from the
simplest to the most complex, namely:
人體的組織結構可以分解成多個層次，從最簡單到最複雜，分別是：
•
Chemical level: different chemicals (E.g. proteins)
化學層面：不同的化學物質(例如蛋白質)
•
Cellular level: single cell
細胞層面：單一細胞
•
Tissue level: groups of similar cells
組織層面：由相似的細胞形成的細胞群體
•
Organ level: discrete structure, which contains two or more types of tissues, for specific functions
器官層面：由兩個或以上的組織組成的獨立結構，用來執行特定的功能
•
Organ system level: several organs that work closely together
系統層面：緊密協作的多個器官
•
Organism level: all organ systems combined to make the whole organism
生物體層面：所有器官系統共同構成整個生物體

slides.title: Important Chemicals in Human Body
slides.english_text:
Important Chemicals in Human Body
• Water
• Most abundant inorganic compound (60%–80% of volume of living cells)
• Important functions:
• (1) Useful solvent
• Dissolves many substances for chemical reactions in body
• Body’s major transport medium
• (2) Stabilize body temperature
• Example: Sweating
• (3) Cushioning to protect organs
• Example: cerebrospinal fluid cushions nervous system organs
• (4) Lubricant to enhance movement
• Example: synovial fluid in joints

• Body’s major transport medium身體的主要運輸介質
(2) Stabilize body temperature 穩定體溫
•
• Example: Sweating 例如：出汗
(3) Cushioning to protect organs 保護器官的緩衝
•
• Example: cerebrospinal fluid cushions nervous system organs

slides.title: Major function of carbohydrate in human body:
slides.english_text:
Major function of carbohydrate in human body:
Major function in human cell is providing a ready and easily used source of fuel.
Glucose is usually the preferred fuel. When glucose is broken down in cell,
chemical energy is released for other reactions in cell.
Excess glucose molecules are changed to glycogen or fat and stored.
